acquisition.description: The Marble Block is a natural block found in Marble Caves.
Granite is a block found underground in Granite Caves.
Pink Gel is a rare crafting material dropped by Pinky in stacks of 25–50.
Sandstone Blocks are blocks found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome.
The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block, along with Sandstone Blocks, that make up the Underground Desert biome.
